name: Bern
flagName: Flag of the Canton of Bern
summary: A red square with a yellow diagonal band carrying a black bear walking upward. The bear is a pun on the city's name.
origin: According to legend, Duke Berthold V of Zähringen, who founded Bern in 1191, named it after the first animal killed in a hunt nearby, a bear. The bear appears on the city's seal from 1224. Bern joined the Confederacy in 1353.

symbols.name: Bear
symbols.description: A black bear with red tongue and claws, climbing the band.

facts: Bern still keeps live bears in the BärenPark near the old town.
Bern is the Swiss federal city, the seat of government.
clues: A black bear on a yellow diagonal band across red.
Its animal gives the city its name, by legend.
The canton of the Swiss federal city.
